How the kit builder works

Choose a camera body from Canon, Fujifilm, Leica, Nikon, Olympus, Panasonic, Sigma and Sony, then add up to six lenses. Only lenses for that body's mount are offered, including third-party lenses and, on shared mounts such as L-Mount and Micro Four Thirds, lenses from the other brands that use it. The kit builder adds up the weight and the list price of the body and its lenses, shows the focal range they cover and the filter sizes they take, and can put a second kit beside the first to compare.

Totals are sums of each item's manufacturer list price; when an item has no list price in your currency, every price is shown in US dollars rather than mixing currencies.
